result.title: Reciprocity Can Erase Direction:tructural Boundaries and Controlled Utility of Magnetic Graph Networks
result.summary: Magnetic graph networks encode direction through phase, but a learned graph can erase the intended directional mechanism before prediction. We characterize this failure for support-based magnetic Laplacians. Exact identities relate imaginary energy and distance from zero phase to amplitude-weighted reciprocity. Top-$k$ selection forces complete collapse when the observed-node count satisfies $m\leq k+1$, and dense support imposes a lower bound on reciprocal-arc fraction. We then construct paired propagation examples with identical node features and symmetric amplitudes but opposite labels, giving a provable chance-level limit for direction-erasing representations. In 72 fixed neural fits, support phase achieved test AUROC 1.0000 on a unilateral ring but 0.5000 on reciprocal ring and complete supports; continuous score phase and a real directed comparator achieved 1.0000 throughout. All models solved the direction-free control. These are oracle-direction mechanism tests, not evidence of learned clinical direction. In the preserved public DeepDRiD development study, continuous phase was active but its robustness difference from zero phase was only $+0.0036$ (descriptive 95\% interval $-0.0014$ to $+0.0095$) on validation patients used for checkpoint selection. The contribution is a structural and experimental framework for distinguishing erased direction from unestablished task utility. It provides a precise circumstance in which magnetic phase preserves useful information, without asserting universal or clinical superiority.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究基于支撑的 magnetic Laplacian 用相位编码有向图方向时，为何会在预测前丢失方向机制：给出互惠性与虚部能量、距零相位距离的恒等式，证明 Top-k 选择在观测节点数 m≤k+1 时完全塌缩，并构造同特征、同振幅但标签相反的传播样例，说明方向被抹除表示的可证随机水平；实验上用固定神经拟合区分支撑相位、连续相位与实数有向对照。文中明确这些是机制性检验，不主张临床方向可学得或普遍优越。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文的「塌缩／信息抹除」判据与「区分信息已被抹除和任务效用本未建立」的框架，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 视觉或关系信息是否真正保留、以及衡量 latent 内容因果贡献提供可核查的诊断思路，但对象是有向图的相位支持结构，与视觉或多模态推理状态距离较远。
